verdicts.reason: Both keep the same orange, serif headline and dark pill CTA, and both read cleanly. A is slightly better balanced, with about 130px above the headline and 65px below the button. Its gap between headline and CTA (~95px) is a bit loose, and the CTA is small next to the headline. B groups the headline and CTA more tightly, but it leaves ~175px of empty space on top and only ~50px under the button, so the block sits low and the CTA feels close to the bottom edge. Neither adds any new design intent.
